# h2o-cube

H2O HOMO/LUMO/density cube generation for visualization

Generated by `scripts/regenerate_doc_examples.py` from the canonical
input `input-h2o-cube.py`.

## Files

- `input-h2o-cube.py`: input script
- `stdout.txt`: full captured stdout from the queued run
- `stderr.txt`: full captured stderr from the queued run
- `artifact-status.json`: machine-readable run status
- `output-h2o-density.cube`
- `output-h2o-mo-homo.cube`
- `output-h2o-mo-lumo.cube`
- `output-h2o-mos.cube`
- `output-h2o-cube.bibtex`
- `output-h2o-cube.molden`
- `output-h2o-cube.out`
- `output-h2o-cube.population.json`
- `output-h2o-cube.population.txt`
- `output-h2o-cube.qvf`
- `output-h2o-cube.references`
- `output-h2o-cube.system`
- `output-h2o-cube.xyz`

## Reproduce

```sh
.venv/bin/python examples/molecular/input-h2o-cube.py
```
